description: Search AIML Rounds lessons by keywords or an interview question. Filter by track (fundamentals, ai-engineering, system-design, papers), type (concept, interview, design, paper) or section/part name. Returns lesson ids for get_lesson.

limit.description: How many lessons to return (1–30, default 8)

query.description: Keywords or a question, e.g. 'KV cache', 'why does RAG retrieve the wrong chunk'

section.description: Part or section name to filter by, e.g. 'RAG', 'LLMs', 'Recommendation Systems'

track.description: Limit to one track: fundamentals, ai-engineering, system-design or papers

type.description: concept = lesson, interview = scenario set, design = system design question, paper = paper explained

name: search
title: Search lessons
